directors.about: Leads Chinoétales as both a company and a creative force, setting the studio's vision while staying hands-on in the director's chair. His signature combines bold visual aesthetics with deeply emotional storytelling, translating lyrical content into powerful visual metaphors.
directors.q: "I believe every song carries a visual story waiting to be discovered. Our job is not to create new stories, but to excavate the emotional truth already embedded in the music."

directors.about: The technical backbone of Chinoétales' image-making, leading the camera department while shaping the studio's broader technical direction and equipment strategy. A cinematographer with a sharp eye for light and composition.
works: Lead DOP across commercials & music videos
directors.q: "Technical excellence is the foundation upon which artistic vision stands. Every decision, from camera movement to colour temperature, serves the story."

directors.about: Holds the financial backbone of Chinoétales together while shaping the visual world of every set she designs, blending a producer's discipline with a designer's eye for emotional authenticity and cultural sensitivity.
directors.q: "The most powerful stories are the ones that feel inevitable, where every visual choice seems like the only possible choice. That's when art happens."

directors.about: Keeps Chinoétales running, the person who turns a creative brief into a schedule, a schedule into a shoot day, and a shoot day into a delivered project. Ground-level experience across productions of every scale means nothing falls through the cracks.
directors.q: "Great productions aren't built on great ideas alone, they're built on flawless execution. My role is making sure the team can focus on the work, not the logistics."

directors.about: Brings fresh, contemporary energy to Chinoétales' creative direction, shaping the studio's evolving visual language, pushing projects toward dynamic, digital-age storytelling while staying rooted in cultural authenticity.
works: Ongoing creative direction across the pipeline
directors.q: "Every generation has its own visual language. My goal is to help our stories find expressions that feel true to this moment, honest, dynamic, and authentic."

directors.about: Shapes the creative backbone of every production, translating raw concepts into a coherent visual and narrative direction, with meticulous composition, complex technical problem-solving, and an unwavering commitment to artistic integrity.
directors.q: "Technology should become invisible so the story can become everything. That's the standard every creative decision has to meet."

directors.about: Brings a sharp visual instinct to every frame he shoots, serving the story through light, movement, and composition rather than spectacle for its own sake, across music videos, commercials, and documentary-style projects.
directors.q: "A shot only works if it disappears into the story. My job is to make every frame feel like it couldn't have been captured any other way."

directors.about: Builds the visual world every Chinoétales project lives in, from set dressing to props to the overall aesthetic language of a production. Art direction is never an afterthought; it's baked into the story from day one.
works: Art direction across music video & commercial projects
directors.q: "Great production design should never call attention to itself, it should just feel like the only world this story could exist in."

directors.about: Supports the art department across every stage of production, from prep and sourcing through on-set execution. An eye for detail that keeps the art department running smoothly under pressure.
directors.q: "The details nobody notices are usually the ones holding the whole shot together."

directors.about: Manages how Chinoétales' work reaches the world, coordinating content across platforms, timelines, and campaigns, from behind-the-scenes documentation to full release strategy for finished projects.
directors.q: "A great film still needs the right story told about how it reaches people. That's the part of the job I care about most."

directors.about: Responsible for the integrity of Chinoétales' footage from the moment it's captured to the moment it reaches the edit suite, data management, on-set backups, and first-pass technical quality checks.
directors.q: "Nobody notices the DIT until something goes wrong. My job is making sure that never happens."

directors.about: Shapes the final rhythm of Chinoétales' projects in the edit suite. With an innate sense of pacing and music-visual synchronisation, his editing is where performance, cinematography, and story finally come together.
directors.q: "Editing is where the story is truly told. When the cuts disappear, that's when the audience stops watching and starts feeling."

directors.about: Shapes how every artist and cast member looks on screen, wardrobe, styling, and the visual identity that has to hold up under studio lights and outdoor locations alike, always built for both camera and story.
directors.q: "Styling isn't decoration, it's characterisation. What someone wears has to tell you who they are before they say a single word."

faq.n: We are a story-driven film studio based in Kathmandu. We direct, shoot, and edit music videos, commercials, documentaries and visual narratives — from the first treatment through to the final grade.

faq.q: How many people are on the team?
faq.n: Thirteen. Direction, cinematography, production design, art direction, editing, styling and the operations that hold it all together are all in-house, and we work with a regular circle of collaborators beyond that.

faq.q: How many films have you made?
faq.n: Over 100 music videos released since 2021, for more than 50 artists and bands.
Yes. We are based in Kathmandu and available for projects anywhere — shoots have taken us across Nepal, and we take on international work.

faq.q: What does a project usually involve?
faq.n: Most begin with a conversation about the song and what it should feel like. From there we build the treatment, assemble the crew, shoot, and deliver the finished film — including the behind-the-scenes cut where the project calls for one.

faq.q: How do I start a project with you?
faq.n: Send us the track and a note about what you have in mind through the contact page. Tell us your timeline and any references, and we will come back to you — we typically respond within 48 hours.
